name: Sant Julià de Cerdanyola (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, purple and green, with a white fleur-de-lis centred on each green stripe.
history: The flag was approved on 25 February 1997 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 2360 of 27 March 1997; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, tierced vertically green, purple and green, with a white fleur-de-lis centred on each of the first and third thirds.

features.role: one fleur-de-lis on each green third
